name: build-v2
script: set -e; export MAKEFLAGS="-j2 -l2"; cd /candidate; colcon --log-base /integration-evidence/build-v2-log build --build-base /integration-build --install-base /integration-install --packages-select mtc_ros2_action_cpp mtc_cpp_mock_bringup --executor sequential --cmake-args -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo -DBUILD_TESTING=ON
argv: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash; source /candidate-install/setup.bash; if [ -f /integration-install/setup.bash ]; then source /integration-install/setup.bash; fi; unset ROS_STATIC_PEERS ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE FASTDDS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE CYCLONEDDS_URI; export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=161 RMW_IMPLEMENTATION=rmw_fastrtps_cpp ROS_AUTOMATIC_DISCOVERY_RANGE=LOCALHOST PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 ROS_LOG_DIR=/integration-evidence/roslogs; set -e; export MAKEFLAGS="-j2 -l2"; cd /candidate; colcon --log-base /integration-evidence/build-v2-log build --build-base /integration-build --install-base /integration-install --packages-select mtc_ros2_action_cpp mtc_cpp_mock_bringup --executor sequential --cmake-args -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo -DBUILD_TESTING=ON
